sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's FA Vase campaign came to a narrow end on Saturday as they fell to a 1-0 defeat against Ashby Ivanhoe in the First Qualifying Round. The Jockeys put in a much-improved second-half display after being caught out early, with Ryman Johnson's unmarked finish in the 14th minute proving decisive. Despite better efforts after the break, Sandbach couldn't find the breakthrough they needed.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth continued their strong start with a 4-1 home win over Crewe, extending their unbeaten run and moving second with 10 points from four games. Wolverhampton Casuals, who lead the table, secured a 1-0 away victory at Dawley Town courtesy of Liam Kirton's second-half goal, though their earlier 100% record was ended by Eccleshall's 2-1 midweek win. Shawbury United bounced back from their first loss with a 3-2 home triumph over Widnes Town in an entertaining affair. In cup action, Eccleshall swept aside Allscott Heath 4-0 in the FA Vase, with Max Chimenes, Nicky Parker, Essa Faburay and Morgan Russell all on target. Bilston Town produced an impressive 3-0 away victory at Brereton Social, while Telford Town advanced via penalties against Darlaston Town after a 1-1 draw. Foley Meir also progressed on penalties, beating Redditch Borough after a goalless draw.
